segments.text: Favorite cake: Her dad's Sachertorte

Kamiogi Academy second-year and the proud new owner of Marshmallow Tree. A perky idealist, her relentless positivity can also read as plain airheaded at times. While not the most naturally gifted at running a business, her smile and straightforward way of warming up to others never fail to win her new fans. Ever ready to lend a helping hand, lost cats and dogs are such a soft spot for her that she has a habit of bringing strays into the shop. In fact, she even "adopts" the protagonist after finding him collapsed and homeless in a nearby park...
From Steam
神扇学園の２年生で、ケーキ屋「マシュマロツリー」の新米オーナー。
明るくほんわかとした雰囲気を持つ、ちょっとアホ残念な女の子。
経営の才能はあまり無いが、親しみやすい性格からまわりに自然と人が集まってくるタイプ。
捨て猫や捨て犬を見過ごせない性格で、公園で行き倒れていた主人公も拾ってきてお店で雇いはじめる。

Kamiogi Academy third-year and Marshmallow Tree's manager-slash-pastry chef. Easily underestimated because of her small stature, she's actually a sensible "big sister" type, at times even bordering on maternalistic. She and Kanon are childhood friends, and she used to help out at Kanon's parents' cake shop growing up. Not-so-secretly harbors an inferiority complex about her height, for which she overcompensates by milking her "big sister" role for all it's worth...
From Steam
神扇学園の３年生で、「マシュマロツリー」のパティシエ。
見た目の小ささとは真逆で、お姉ちゃん属性がある世話焼きで母性あふれる女の子。
花音とは幼なじみの親友で子供のときからお店を手伝っている古参。
小柄で子供っぽい外見にコンプレックスを持っており「頼れるお姉ちゃん」になりたいと日々思っている。

Kamiogi Academy first-year and acclaimed picture-book author/illustrator. Timid and chronically self-sabotaging, she's quick to jump to negative conclusions and run with them to perplexingly imaginative extremes... While her talents as an artist have made her a household name practically overnight, the pressure she feels to complete her next big book has sunk her into a major creative slump. She's also a huge fan of cakes and tea, and as such, is a frequent customer at Marshmallow Tree.
From Steam
神扇学園の１年生で、絵本作家。
一見大人しくておどおどしているが、動揺すると極端なネガティブ思考になりとんでもないことを口走る。
絵本作家として才能もあり評価も高いが、まわりの期待がプレッシャーになって描けなくなってしまった。
紅茶とケーキが好きで、「マシュマロツリー」によく通っている。

Kamiogi Academy second-year and globally renowned pâtissière at Souvenir, a popular rival cake chain. Her public persona is that of a mysterious, unapproachable “ice queen”; in reality, she talks like a tired office worker with a bewilderingly hit-or-miss sense of humor. Half-Finnish and half-Japanese, she relocated to Japan only a few years ago, but seems to have already lost her passion for baking cakes...
From Steam

From Shiravune
